verdict.rationale: Stagehand ships a built-in `agent` primitive that turns high-level tasks into fully autonomous browser workflows, with configurable LLM provider and model, custom instructions, and max steps. It also supports caching agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts and using the agent as a fallback when a single `act()` becomes a multi-step flow. Missing for 10: agent docs appear only under v3 with no v4 equivalent in the pack, it is a developer SDK primitive rather than an interactive in-product assistant, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent delegation quality.
